newsitem.title: USA: US jet holds its own with NYMEX, but diffs slide.
newsitem.headline: US jet holds its own with NYMEX, but diffs slide.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices ended steady to moderately higher on Friday thanks to a 0.65- cent gain in October futures, but differentials slid in both centers as sellers dominated thin trade, players said.
Gulf Coast low-sulfur 55 grade saw diffs ease 0.60 cent to an offering price of 2.30 cents above the print, players said.
"There were a few inquiries in the past few days for 55-grade to go to Europe, but that talk seemed to have died off today," one Gulf player said.
Differentials on New York Harbor 54-grade eased 0.75 cent, traders said, and weakened 0.20 cent on the Gulf Coast.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
